tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit, normal MCV/MCH), with a slightly elevated erythrocyte count. Platelet count is normal, but both mean platelet volume and platelet distribution width are increased, suggesting larger and more variable platelets, possibly indicating increased platelet turnover or activation. No leukocyte abnormalities. Correlation with clinical context and further evaluation for anemia and platelet changes is recommended.
